facts.statement: The genus Boluochia was first described by Zhou in 1995.
facts.quote:
Boluochia

genus: Boluochia
parent_authority: Zhou, 1995
species: zhengi

facts.statement: Boluochia lived during the Early Cretaceous, specifically between 121.6 and 110.6 million years ago.
facts.quote: It lived during the Early Cretaceous in the time span 121.6-110.6 mya (late Aptian-early Albian)

facts.statement: Fossils of Boluochia are known from the Jiufotang Formation in Liaoning province, China.
facts.quote: It lived during the Early Cretaceous in the time span 121.6-110.6 mya (late Aptian-early Albian) and is known from fossils found in the Jiufotang Formation of Liaoning province, People's Republic of China.

facts.statement: A re-analysis by Jingmai O'Connor and colleagues assigned Boluochia to the family Longipterygidae.
facts.quote: A re-analysis of the specimen by Jingmai O'Connor and colleagues found that it was closely related to Longipteryx and could be assigned to the family Longipterygidae.

facts.statement: Although originally described with a hooked beak, further research suggests Boluochia had a normal, toothed, and elongated snout.
facts.quote: While it was originally described as having a hooked, raptorial beak, the specimen is badly preserved, and further research suggested that it instead had a normal, toothed, and probably elongated snout like other longipterygids.

facts.statement: The fourth metatarsal diverges significantly in Boluochia, separating the outer toe when perched, a feature present on both feet and not seen in juvenile Longipteryx.
facts.quote: The researchers who noted this characteristic argued that it was not likely to be a deformity because it was present on both feet, and that it was not a juvenile characteristic, as it is not seen in known juvenile specimens of Longipteryx.

facts.statement: The species Boluochia zhengi was described by Zhang et al. in 2001.

facts.statement: Boluochia zhengi lived during the Early Cretaceous, approximately 120 million years ago in the Aptian.
facts.quote: Boluochia zhengi es un género de ave enantiornite que vivió durante el Cretácico Inferior, hace 120 millones de años, en el Aptiano.

facts.statement: Boluochia is classified as an enantiornithean bird.
facts.quote: Boluochia zhengi es un género de ave enantiornite que vivió durante el Cretácico Inferior, hace 120 millones de años, en el Aptiano.

facts.statement: The Paleobiology Database records the time range for Boluochia as 121.4 to 113.2 million years ago.
facts.quote: Time range: Aptian to Aptian (121.4 to 113.2 million years ago)
